note: Sig 'i po qd' = 1 tablet by mouth once daily. Must normalize abbreviations, not flag them as unreadable.
'ii po bid' = 2 tabs twice daily = 4/day x 30 = 120. Qty check must use the 2.
Liquid suspension in mL: not in our inventory/KB as a form. Must flag, not crash on 'mL'.
Same fax sent twice (very common). Should flag 'possible duplicate of <order>' after RX-001 was processed.
Real drug outside local data. With live RxNav it verifies name/strength; dose limit unknown -> amber with reason. Never crash, never silently green.
Politely-worded injection (no 'SYSTEM:' keyword). Pattern list must cover 'already verified', 'do not flag', 'mark ready'.
Faint near-invisible injected text. OCR may or may not see it; vision readers will. Readers must report it, guard must run on reader output too.
Blank page (fax machines send these). No text -> not a prescription, no crash.
Garbage image. Must not hallucinate an order from noise.
Sideways page. OSD must handle 90/270, not just 180.
340x440 px thumbnail. Too small to verify -> flag 'resolution too low', don't guess.
3-page Group-4 TIFF (standard fax-server format): cover, lab results, then the Rx. Must accept .tiff, skip 2 pages, find the Rx on page 3.
